existing_terminology:
No Swiss term can be drawn from the sources this entry cites, and none is invented here
The IS1406 volume has no Swiss version: its German version names the German and Austrian team
Its French version is the France version; neither is attributed to Swiss representatives
The book chapter cited, doi 10.4324/9780429455308-40, is not open access and returned no text
existing_identificationCriteria:
Acceding cantons name the authority that orders special-education measures
Assessment bodies must not be the same bodies as the service providers
Individual need is determined within a standardised assessment procedure
Threshold in words: cannot follow mainstream lessons without specific support
existing_multilingualProvision:
Practitioner perceptions, not policy — COST IS1406 survey 2017, n = 208 (Law et al., 2020)
Assessment: mainstream only 44%, both 18%, mother tongue if different 13%
Intervention: mainstream only 73%, two+ languages 11%
Interpreters sometimes used — assessment 76%, intervention 22%, counselling 90%
Practitioner training: obligatory 6%, optional 57%, none 23%, unsure 11% (n = 218)
existing_referralPathway:
Parents must be brought into the process of ordering special-education measures
The authority that orders the measures also determines the service providers
Trigger: measures taken before school or in the mainstream prove insufficient
Age gate: birth to the completed twentieth year, and resident in Switzerland
existing_serviceModel:
Practitioner-reported, COST IS1406 survey 2017, n = 372 from Switzerland (Law et al., 2020)
Settings: mainstream school 56%, nursery/kindergarten 33%, private practice 28%
Sector: public education 76%, private 26%
Direct intervention most often weekly — 51%
Access shaped by: parental education 44%, linguistic/cultural community 40%, urban/rural 34%
existing_legalEntitlement:
BehiG (SR 151.3) art 20: cantons must secure basic schooling fitted to special needs
The 2007 special-education concordat gives a right to appropriate measures
Free of charge is the principle; meals and care may still be charged for
Redress: a person disadvantaged by the state may ask a court to remove it
existing_funding:
One case per practitioner, more than one funder allowed — COST IS1406 2017, n = 372
Funders: state education 81%, state health 17%
36% said a maximum number of sessions applied (n = 371)
existing_workforce:
Basic training of special-needs staff is set by EDK recognition rules or federal law
Acceding cantons apply uniform quality standards for recognising service providers
existing_outcomesEvidence:
Counted by official decision, not by need, so no type of difficulty is separated
Cantonal figures come from an annual survey in all schools
21,801 primary-age learners held an official decision in 2022/23, 15,145 of them boys
Upper secondary is blank: no data on learners with an official decision at that level
The standard procedure covers low-incidence disability; schools handle high-incidence

Sernám (National Pedagogical-Psychological Counselling Centre), Fakøki: Tala
Sernám, English
Sernám, Kunningarskriv: Virksemi hjá Sernámi, 5 April 2023
Sernám, Tíðindi: Mirjam bjóðar okkum við til talupedagog, 27 January 2020
Sernám, Starvsfólk (the centre's own staff list, read August 2026)
Hagstova Føroya (Statistics Faroe Islands), Public school

existing_terminology:
Sernám frames need as avbjóðingar within samskifti, mál og talu
Speech clinician is an audiologopedur or logopedur, in everyday use taliráðgevi
Talupedagogur is the term Sernám uses for a therapist seeing a child who stammers
existing_identificationCriteria:
Non-temporary serundirvísing must rest on a pedagogical/psychological kanning
The assessment is carried out in consultation with the pupil and the parents
The minister sets what a pedagogical and psychological kanning must cover
Sernám makes its own professional assessment of need in each individual case
existing_referralPathway:
Parent or staff concern goes to the setting's sernámsfundur, its special-needs meeting
Newborns with evident need are notified to Sernám directly by the National Hospital
Parents may decline what is offered - Sernám records examples of refusal
existing_serviceModel:
Work runs primarily via the child's dagstovn or skúli, day-care centre or school
Sernám is the national pedagogical-psychological counselling centre for the islands
Advisory only - school or day-care leadership decides what it takes up with Sernám
In day-care and nurseries tala/samskifti is one of two areas engaged from the start
existing_legalEntitlement:
Sernám's legal basis is Fólkaskúlalógin section 4, subsections 5 and 6
Pupils needing special measures, or without satisfactory results, get serundirvísing
Pre-school support is discretionary - the minister kann, may, grant it, not skal
A læruætlan, individual teaching plan, is made for pupils on serundirvísing
existing_funding:
The municipal council runs the schools and sets each school's annual budget frame
Home or institution teaching: treasury pays teacher pay, the council bears other costs
existing_workforce:
Eight staff carry the title taliráðgevi on Sernám's own staff list, read 2026
One further post is titled audiologopedur and orðblindaráðgevi, dyslexia adviser
First professionals on a newborn case: a physio or OT, and a taliráðgevi
existing_outcomesEvidence: Not established from the sources consulted for this entry — Statistics Faroe Islands publishes public school and leisure-time education under Education and nothing on special needs or on language; the figures themselves sit in a StatBank that returned no readable text to this pipeline, and the two education paths tried under hagstova.fo returned 404. If you work in this system, this is exactly the field to fill in.

existing_terminology:
Disturbo del linguaggio is a named statutory category in its own right
Defined as reduced speech and expressive or receptive language for age and IQ
Grouped with dyslexia, dysgraphia, dyscalculia and motor coordination disorder
The umbrella term is disturbi evolutivi specifici
existing_identificationCriteria:
Adequate cognitive capacity is required for the disorder to count
So is the absence of neurological pathology and of sensory deficits
Definitions are to be read in light of evolving scientific knowledge
existing_referralPathway:
The school must run early identification in the first years of schooling
Diagnosis is by the state health and social-health services, at the family's request
The school must notify families where difficulties persist despite targeted work
Private diagnoses count only if validated by those services
existing_serviceModel:
Class teachers draft an individual teaching plan with specialist services and the family
Compulsory within the first two months
Compensatory tools and dispensative measures are both statutory entitlements
existing_legalEntitlement:
Only in cases of particular severity may a pupil be exonerated from the third language
Pupils so exonerated can still sit the lower secondary examination
existing_funding: The inclusion commission was set up with no new or greater charge on public finance
existing_workforce: Adequate training on these disorders is a statutory aim for all school staff
existing_outcomesEvidence: Not established from the sources consulted for this entry — Legge 142/2014 makes the Commissione Tecnica per l'Inclusione Scolastica the body responsible for monitoring, trialling and evaluating interventions, and requires the educational and dispensative measures to be put to periodic monitoring to judge their effectiveness, but no output of that monitoring was found published. The Osservatorio Scolastico of the Dipartimento Istruzione publishes only pupil counts by school site and class year, with no disturbi evolutivi or special-needs breakdown and no attainment figures. San Marino has no European Agency country page. If you work in this system, this is exactly the field to fill in.

Schulgesetz vom 15. Dezember 1971 (SchulG), LR 411.0
Verordnung ueber die schulischen Foerdermassnahmen (SchulFMV), LR 411.011
Amt für Statistik, Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Bildungsstatistik 2021

existing_terminology:
No distinct language-disorder category: speech therapy sits inside a generic frame
Need is defined by impairment of educational, developmental and learning opportunities
existing_identificationCriteria:
Enhanced measures are authorised by the competent school authority
Enhanced measures require a standardised assessment process
Ordinary measures come first, without a formal assessment gate
existing_multilingualProvision:
Remedial school measures may also be used for children with a different mother tongue
Separate German-as-a-second-language provision exists alongside them
existing_referralPathway:
Early remedial education covers birth to school start, run centrally
Supplementary teaching is the in-school first line
existing_serviceModel:
Speech therapy is delivered by specialists cooperating with in-school teachers
Five named strands including a school psychological service and gifted support
existing_legalEntitlement:
Entitlement runs from birth to age 20, and to 22 in certain circumstances
The stated aim is that the child stays in or returns to the regular class
existing_funding:
Special schooling is free of charge, and so are the measures added to it
Travel over 30 km to the provider is reimbursed to parents at the cheapest rate
Transport costs are covered where they relate directly to the school journey
Boarding special school: parents may be charged 15 francs a day for meals
Parents bear the extra cost if they ask for costlier special schooling than needed
existing_workforce:
Delivery goes to qualified individuals or private institutions with qualified staff
Qualified means a diploma of a recognised special-needs university or Fachhochschule
The state must ensure domestic providers cover the need for these measures
Where a contracted provider cannot, the Schulamt may commission specialised bodies
existing_outcomesEvidence:
School children are counted by stage and school type, the Sonderschule among them
Sonderschule pupils are broken down by sociodemographic characteristics and school place
The Amt fuer Statistik in Vaduz publishes the Bildungsstatistik
